title: 10-day-old boy with vomiting
arrival: A 10-day-old boy is brought in by his mother after vomiting once earlier today. He was born without complications following a normal pregnancy.
keyCriterion: Yellow — Other: any infant 8 days to 6 months old (age alone)
feedbackWhy: He is 10 days old, which falls within the 8-days-to-6-months band. Age alone meets yellow criteria, even though he is well appearing and has no high-risk vital signs.

airway_red.text: No stridor. No central cyanosis. No respiratory distress.

circulation_red.text: Strong pulse. Warm extremities. Normal capillary refill.

disability_red.text: No convulsions. No altered mental status, stiff neck or fever.

airway_yellow.text: No swelling of the mouth, throat or neck. No wheezing.

circulation_yellow.text: Feeding well. No dehydration, ongoing diarrhoea or severe pallor.

disability_yellow.text: Settled. Not irritable or lethargic. Not in severe pain.

exampleShows: At 10 days old, he falls in the 8-days-to-6-months age band.
Age alone meets a yellow criterion, even though he is well appearing and has no high-risk vital signs.
